sql: with t as ( select split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',1) as ser, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) as contest, pt.market_ticker as tk, pt.strategy as bk, pt.side as sd, case when pt.side = 'no' then 100 - pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end as ypx, pt.pnl::float as pnl from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLSPREAD','KXNFLTOTAL','KXNFLGAME','KXNFL1HSPREAD','KXNFL1HTOTAL', 'KXNCAAFSPREAD','KXNCAAFTOTAL','KXNCAAFGAME','KXMLBSPREAD','KXMLBTOTAL') ), nfl as (select * from t where ser = 'KXNFLSPREAD'), cst as (select contest, count(distinct tk) m, count(distinct tk) filter (where pnl<0) lm, sum(pnl) p, count(*) nt from nfl group by 1), u as ( select 'E_series'::text sec, ser::text k, count(*) nt, count(distinct tk) m, count(distinct contest) c, sum(pnl) p, avg(ypx) e, count(distinct tk) filter (where pnl<0) lm from t group by 2 union all select 'F_band', case when ypx<=7 then 'a_<=7' when ypx<=11 then 'b_08-11' when ypx<=20 then 'c_12-20' else 'd_21+' end, count(*), count(distinct tk), count(distinct contest), sum(pnl), avg(ypx), count(distinct tk) filter (where pnl<0) from nfl group by 2 union all select 'G_side', coalesce(sd,'null'), count(*), count(distinct tk), count(distinct contest), sum(pnl), avg(ypx), count(distinct tk) filter (where pnl<0) from nfl group by 2 union all select 'H_lossper_contest', lpad(lm::text,2,'0'), sum(nt), sum(m), count(*), sum(p), null, sum(lm) from cst group by 2 union all select 'I_mkts_per_contest', lpad(m::text,2,'0'), sum(nt), sum(m), count(*), sum(p), null, sum(lm) from cst group by 2 ) select sec, k, nt trades, m mkts, c contests, round(p::numeric,2) pnl_usd, round((100*p/nullif(nt,0))::numeric,2) c_per_trade, round(e::numeric,2) entry_yes_c, lm loss_mkts, round((100.0*lm/nullif(m,0))::numeric,1) mkt_loss_pct from u order by sec, k
purpose: KXNFLSPREAD: band, side, contest clustering, sibling series
